I’m a US real estate investor. I use this @Bot before I get attached to a house.

I paste a US address (or a Zillow / Redfin / Realtor link).
It scores the house six ways: rent-by-the-room, long-term rental, mid-term rental, short-term rental, flip, and BRRRR.
I get a short… https://t.co/qCnigwhQjW

— TanyaZ (@TZitsnotjustAI) September 20, 2026
